Cleaning is a breeze, both the cup and infuser rinse out easily, and I’ve even put it in the top rack of the dishwasher with no issues.

reviews_1s:
I was excited about this glass tea cup because of its sleek design and promised durability. However, the biggest flaw is that it conducts way too much heat. The moment I pour hot tea into it, the entire cup becomes too hot to touch. I have to wait several minutes just to hold it comfortably, which defeats the purpose of enjoying a warm beverage.

Additionally, there’s no insulation or double-walled design to protect your hands, so you’ll definitely need a coaster or a separate sleeve. While it looks nice, the practicality is seriously lacking.

If you’re planning to use this for hot drinks, think twice unless you enjoy juggling with oven mitts. Would not recommend for daily use.Do not put infuser in dishwasher if it jiggles.
